mapper.update: UPDATE convenience_service SET name = #{name}, category_code = #{categoryCode}, summary = #{summary}, description = #{description}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, address = #{address}, cover_image_path = #{coverImagePath}, max_capacity = #{maxCapacity}, audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_reason = #{auditReason}, reviewed_by = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE convenience_service SET service_status = #{serviceStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE convenience_service SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_reason = #{auditReason}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE convenience_service SET service_status = CASE WHEN current_booked + 1 >= max_capacity THEN 'FULL' ELSE 'RESERVABLE' END, current_booked = current_booked + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND service_status = 'RESERVABLE' AND current_booked < max_capacity
mapper.select: SELECT id, provider_id, name, category_code, summary, description, contact_name, contact_phone, address, cover_image_path, service_status, audit_status, audit_reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, max_capacity, current_booked, avg_score, score_count, created_at, updated_at FROM convenience_service WHERE id = #{id}
